login_subtitle: Welcome back to your inner world.
home_tagline: Discover what your dreams reveal about you.
home_hero_title: Discover what your dreams reveal about you.
home_hero_body: At DreamTells Dreams, every image, sensation, and symbol gains meaning through our advanced AI, capable of analyzing emotions, patterns, and hidden messages. Share your dream and receive a clear, deep, and personalized interpretation — designed to help you understand your mind, your soul, and what your life is trying to show you while you sleep.
